key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:libs/diskfont.library:7:0224
name: register_best_matching_font
description: Library code that repeatedly scores font entries in a loop and keeps the highest-scoring candidate. For matching entries it loads a segment through the dos library, links the entry into the font list with AddFont and AddTail, and returns the chosen entry.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:libs/diskfont.library:7:0304

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:libs/diskfont.library:7:0322
name: close_font_and_select_entry
description: Library code that closes a font's graphics handle and frees its memory, then runs the same highest-score selection loop over the remaining entries. It releases the file, lock and directory resources before returning the selected entry.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:libs/diskfont.library:5:0000
name: build_font_table_from_path
description: Library code that takes a file path, replaces its extension with the text .font, and locks the result. It walks the directory entries and, for each match, allocates a table record and copies the entry name and attribute bytes into it, returning the table or a null result on failure.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:libs/diskfont.library:5:00BA
name: load_disk_font_table

It copies the name and attribute bytes of each matching entry into the table, updating the count, and returns the table or a null result.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:libs/diskfont.library:5:0240
name: free_sized_memory_block
description: Library code that reads the size stored four bytes before the pointer it receives and passes the block and that size to FreeMem. It frees one memory block and does nothing else.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:libs/diskfont.library:9:0000
name: copy_null_terminated_string

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:libs/diskfont.library:9:0010
name: append_string_at_terminator
description: Advances a pointer to the zero terminator of a string and passes that end position and a second argument to the copy routine. This appends text to the end of an existing string.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:libs/diskfont.library:9:001A
name: skip_string_end_and_call
description: Advances a pointer to the zero terminator of a string and then calls a library function through the library base with that pointer. It performs no other work.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:libs/diskfont.library:9:002C
name: measure_string_length
description: Counts the bytes of a zero-terminated string before its terminator and returns the count.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:libs/diskfont.library:9:0034
name: count_null_terminated_bytes
description: Adds to a starting count while advancing through bytes until a zero byte is reached. It returns the final total.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:libs/diskfont.library:9:003C
name: compare_null_terminated_strings
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings byte by byte. It returns a negative value when the first differing byte of the first string is smaller, zero when the strings match, and a positive value otherwise.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:libs/diskfont.library:9:0046
name: compare_string_prefix_ordering
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings byte by byte and stops with zero as soon as the first string ends. On a mismatch it returns a negative or positive ordering value.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:libs/diskfont.library:9:004E
name: compare_strings_register_args
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings passed in address registers, returning zero when they match and a negative or positive ordering value at the first differing byte.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:libs/diskfont.library:9:0062
name: find_char_forward_in_string
description: Scans forward through a zero-terminated string for a given byte. It returns a pointer to the first match, or a null result if the terminator is reached first.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:libs/diskfont.library:9:006C
name: find_char_forward_register_args
description: Scans forward through a zero-terminated string for the byte held in a data register, checking the current byte before advancing. It returns a pointer to the first match or a null result at the terminator.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:libs/diskfont.library:9:0074
name: find_next_char_after_position
description: Advances past the current byte and scans forward for a byte held in a register. It returns a pointer to the match, or a null result when the terminator is reached.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:libs/diskfont.library:9:007E
name: find_last_char_in_string
description: Measures a zero-terminated string and scans backward from its last byte for a given byte. It returns a pointer to the last occurrence, or a null result when the byte does not occur.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:libs/diskfont.library:9:009C
name: find_char_backward_bounded
description: Scans backward from a pointer toward a lower bound, checking the current byte before stepping back. It returns the position of the matching byte, or a null result when the bound is passed.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:libs/diskfont.library:9:00A4
name: find_previous_char_bounded
description: Steps a pointer back one byte and then checks it against a lower bound and a byte held in a register. It returns the position of the match, or a null result when the bound is passed first.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:libs/diskfont.library:9:00B2
name: skip_path_prefix_to_name
description: Looks for a slash in a path, or failing that a colon, and returns the position just after the first one found. If neither is present it returns the original pointer, giving the file name part of the path.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a].adf:c/Binddrivers:0:0000
name: parse_command_line
description: Allocates a control block and, when the program was started from the command line, splits the raw argument text into zero-terminated strings stored in a linked list. When started from Workbench it records the startup message instead, then returns a status code.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a].adf:c/Binddrivers:2:0000
name: bind_expansion_drivers
description: Opens the expansion and icon libraries, then reads a list of driver entries and for each one derives a name, finds the matching expansion device and binds its driver. It frees its temporary buffer and closes the libraries before returning.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a].adf:c/Binddrivers:2:01E6
name: find_self_referencing_resident_tag
description: Walks forward through a memory block looking for a resident tag, a marker word whose stored address points back to the tag itself. It returns the address of the first match, or a null result when the block ends first.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a].adf:c/Binddrivers:2:021C
name: accumulate_pipe_separated_fields
description: Walks a string of entries separated by vertical bars, measuring each entry and passing its start and length to another routine that updates an accumulated value. It returns the final accumulated value.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a].adf:c/Binddrivers:2:0268
name: parse_numeric_path_segment
description: Splits a name at its first slash and checks whether the leading part is all digits. If it is, it parses that number and derives a second value from the remainder, passing both to another routine; otherwise it returns zero.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a].adf:c/Binddrivers:2:02F8
name: collect_flagged_nodes_into_list
description: Walks a list of nodes and, for each node with a particular flag bit set that is not already in the output list, pushes it onto the front of that list through its link field. It returns the head of the rebuilt list.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a].adf:c/Binddrivers:2:034A
name: follow_parent_chain
description: Walks a chain of nodes through the link field at a fixed offset, stopping at a null node or at the target node. It returns the last pointer reached together with a flag saying whether the target was found.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a].adf:c/Binddrivers:2:0368
name: check_digit_prefix
description: Checks the first given number of bytes of a string for decimal digits. It returns zero when every one of them is a digit and one when a non-digit is found, or when the length is zero.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a].adf:c/Binddrivers:2:0396
name: parse_decimal_integer
description: Reads consecutive decimal digit characters from a string, accumulating their value, and stops at the first non-digit or the terminator. It returns the resulting number.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a].adf:c/Binddrivers:2:03C6
name: check_result_within_limit
description: Calls another routine with the first argument and a sign-extended byte, then returns zero if the first argument plus the third argument is less than that result. Otherwise it returns the result unchanged.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a].adf:c/Binddrivers:4:0006
name: compare_strings_unsigned_order
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings byte by byte as unsigned values. It returns a negative value when the first differing byte is less than the other, one when it is greater, and zero when the strings match.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a].adf:c/Binddrivers:4:0020
name: measure_zero_terminated_length
description: Counts the bytes before the zero terminator by counting an accumulator down from negative one and returning the complement of the final value.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a].adf:c/Binddrivers:4:0024
name: measure_string_length_in_register
description: Counts the bytes before the zero terminator by counting an accumulator down from negative one and returning the complement of the final value. The string pointer is taken from an address register.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a].adf:c/Binddrivers:4:0030

description: Scans a zero-terminated string from its start for a given byte and returns a pointer to the first match. It returns a null result if the terminator is reached first.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a].adf:c/Binddrivers:4:004C
name: copy_c_string

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a].adf:c/Binddrivers:4:0058

description: Reads a pair of values and checks that the high one does not exceed the low one, then runs a further check. If both pass it returns the first value plus the argument minus the high value, otherwise it returns zero.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a].adf:c/EndCLI:0:0136

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a].adf:King's Bounty:0:01CC

description: Copies font name text into a buffer and reads font file records with a read routine, storing one record per match. It returns a shortfall amount, or zero when all records fitted.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a].adf:libs/diskfont.library:3:01B8
name: scan_font_directory_records
description: Walks a directory with examine and next-entry calls, and for each entry that is a font file it reads the records into a buffer, releasing its lock and memory afterward. It returns a shortfall amount, or zero when everything fitted.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a].adf:libs/diskfont.library:3:025C
name: return_zero_stub
description: Returns zero immediately and does nothing else.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a].adf:libs/diskfont.library:7:0000
name: score_font_entry_match
description: Scores how closely a font entry matches a requested font by comparing its size with a stored size and weighing each differing flag bit against a table of values. It returns the score, using a fixed low sentinel when the entry has no size.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a].adf:libs/diskfont.library:7:002E
name: sum_flag_mismatch_weights
description: Subtracts a table weight from an accumulated score for each flag bit that differs between two entries across seven bit positions, and returns the total.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a].adf:libs/diskfont.library:7:0082
name: sum_flag_mismatch_weights_loop
description: Walks the flag bits of two entries, subtracting a table weight from an accumulated score for each mismatch, and returns the score once every bit position has been checked.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a].adf:libs/diskfont.library:7:00B8
name: sum_flag_mismatch_weights_alt
description: Walks the flag bits of two entries, subtracting a table weight from an accumulated score for each mismatch, and returns the score once every bit position has been checked.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a].adf:libs/diskfont.library:7:00D2
name: return_low_sentinel_value
description: Returns a fixed large negative sentinel value and takes no arguments.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a].adf:libs/diskfont.library:7:00E0
name: open_font_from_name
description: Opens the requested font through the graphics library and, if that fails, searches the FONTS: directory for the best-scoring matching font file and loads it into the font list. It returns the font entry chosen, or zero when none is found.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a].adf:libs/diskfont.library:7:0142
name: select_best_font_in_directory
description: Locks the FONTS: directory and repeatedly selects the highest-scoring font entry, loading matches through the file routines. It releases the lock and returns the selected entry.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a].adf:libs/diskfont.library:7:015E
name: load_best_matching_font_file
description: Opens a font file, reads its records and repeatedly selects the highest-scoring entry, loading matches into the font list. It returns the chosen entry, or zero when none matches.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a].adf:libs/diskfont.library:7:021C
name: select_highest_scoring_font_entry
description: Repeatedly scores the candidate entries, keeping the highest-scoring one, and returns the last entry chosen when no candidate remains.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a].adf:libs/diskfont.library:7:0224
name: register_best_matching_font
description: Library code that repeatedly scores font entries in a loop and keeps the highest-scoring candidate. For matching entries it loads a segment through the dos library, links the entry into the font list with AddFont and AddTail, and returns the chosen entry.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a].adf:libs/diskfont.library:7:0304
name: unload_font_segment_and_rescan
description: Library code that unloads a font segment with UnLoadSeg, then loops over the candidate entries to pick the one with the highest score. It links matching entries into the font list and returns the chosen entry.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a].adf:libs/diskfont.library:7:0322
name: close_font_and_select_entry
description: Library code that closes a font's graphics handle and frees its memory, then runs the same highest-score selection loop over the remaining entries. It releases the file, lock and directory resources before returning the selected entry.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a].adf:libs/diskfont.library:5:0000
name: build_font_table_from_path
description: Library code that takes a file path, replaces its extension with the text .font, and locks the result. It walks the directory entries and, for each match, allocates a table record and copies the entry name and attribute bytes into it, returning the table or a null result on failure.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a].adf:libs/diskfont.library:5:00BA
name: load_disk_font_table
description: Library code that counts directory entries until none remain, then allocates a cleared memory block for a font table with a 16-bit count and an initial header field. It copies the name and attribute bytes of each matching entry into the table, updating the count, and returns the table or a null result.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a].adf:libs/diskfont.library:5:0240
name: free_sized_memory_block
description: Library code that reads the size stored four bytes before the pointer it receives and passes the block and that size to FreeMem. It frees one memory block and does nothing else.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a].adf:libs/diskfont.library:9:0000
name: copy_null_terminated_string
description: Copies bytes from a source string to a destination, including the zero terminator, stopping after the terminator is copied.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a].adf:libs/diskfont.library:9:0010
name: append_string_at_terminator
description: Advances a pointer to the zero terminator of a string and passes that end position and a second argument to the copy routine. This appends text to the end of an existing string.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a].adf:libs/diskfont.library:9:001A
name: skip_string_end_and_call
description: Advances a pointer to the zero terminator of a string and then calls a library function through the library base with that pointer. It performs no other work.

name: measure_string_length
description: Counts the bytes of a zero-terminated string before its terminator and returns the count.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a].adf:libs/diskfont.library:9:0034
name: count_null_terminated_bytes
description: Adds to a starting count while advancing through bytes until a zero byte is reached. It returns the final total.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a].adf:libs/diskfont.library:9:003C
name: compare_null_terminated_strings
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings byte by byte. It returns a negative value when the first differing byte of the first string is smaller, zero when the strings match, and a positive value otherwise.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a].adf:libs/diskfont.library:9:0046
name: compare_string_prefix_ordering
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings byte by byte and stops with zero as soon as the first string ends. On a mismatch it returns a negative or positive ordering value.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a].adf:libs/diskfont.library:9:004E
name: compare_strings_register_args
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings passed in address registers, returning zero when they match and a negative or positive ordering value at the first differing byte.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a].adf:libs/diskfont.library:9:0062
name: find_char_forward_in_string
description: Scans forward through a zero-terminated string for a given byte. It returns a pointer to the first match, or a null result if the terminator is reached first.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a].adf:libs/diskfont.library:9:006C
name: find_char_forward_register_args
description: Scans forward through a zero-terminated string for the byte held in a data register, checking the current byte before advancing. It returns a pointer to the first match or a null result at the terminator.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a].adf:libs/diskfont.library:9:0074
name: find_next_char_after_position

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a].adf:libs/diskfont.library:9:007E
name: find_last_char_in_string
description: Measures a zero-terminated string and scans backward from its last byte for a given byte. It returns a pointer to the last occurrence, or a null result when the byte does not occur.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a].adf:libs/diskfont.library:9:009C
name: find_char_backward_bounded
description: Scans backward from a pointer toward a lower bound, checking the current byte before stepping back. It returns the position of the matching byte, or a null result when the bound is passed.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a].adf:libs/diskfont.library:9:00A4
name: find_previous_char_bounded
description: Steps a pointer back one byte and then checks it against a lower bound and a byte held in a register. It returns the position of the match, or a null result when the bound is passed first.
